title: Rank-one compact weak generator for derived modules
statement: For any ring S in universe w, with the indicated derived category of ModuleCat.{max w vH} S and coproducts indexed in max w vH, the explicit object P = (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of S (ULift.{vH} S)) is compact [def-pc-compact-object] and a weak triangulated generator [def-pc-generators]. No commutativity or nonzero-ring hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: The rank-one free module calculation in the first paragraph.

proof.text: Apply derivedModule_rankOne_compact and derivedModule_rankOne_generator to the same explicit rank-one single object, then introduce the conjunction.

proof_origin.place: Separate the compactness and weak-generation clauses; assemble their conjunction.
